description: The data center campus planned from a projected load: IT grows 12 → 24 → 36 MW over 2027, 2030 and 2035 while the utility energizes the 40 MW connection in steps (20 MW until 2030). Genset and battery candidates per period, so the plan says what to build when. Multi-period; tagged for an Energy Hub study.

study_notes: Each period is the same representative July week, with the period's load and import cap.
Candidates are one row per period (build_year = the period): the plan says what to build when.
The energization schedule caps the import at 20 MW in 2027.
Load is picked up in 2.5 MW blocks after an islanding (assumed): the island rows then follow the load, so the plan stages — a small genset in 2027 and 2030, the bulk in 2035.

After a solve the investment case runs on the shipped commercial config and finance inputs: the existing campus is in service in 2027 at no capex, each candidate the plan builds is a stage with its own COD, and an unbuilt later candidate is not an investment.
